summary: Atomic Server is a knowledge graph database that combines document editing, tabular data management, and search functionality into a single system. It exposes a linked data application programming interface and is designed to operate as a lightweight, self-contained service without external dependencies.
goodFor: It suits technical users who want a self-hosted alternative to Notion backed by a structured graph database and an accessible linked data interface.
watchOut: Being a beta-stage project, you should expect potential breaking changes in updates and a smaller community compared to established proprietary tools.
deployNotes: You can typically run it via Docker with persistent volume mounts for your data, placing a reverse proxy in front for Transport Layer Security.
